Piglet: Did you see Pooh?
Tigger: No.
Eeyore: No.
Piglet: He left this message and disappeared. Where did he go?
(I'll be back when spring comes. - Pooh)
Owl: I know. He went to the Rocky Mountains. He will sleep during the winter.
Piglet: The Rocky Mountains? How far is it from here?
Owl: It's about 50km.
Tigger: How long will he sleep?
Owl: He'll sleep for about four months.
Piglet: I miss him.
Eeyore: Me, too.
Piglet: Let's have a big party when he comes back.
Eeyore: Lets clean his house before he comes back.

<보기>
• before, after, as soon as, while, until
• come, disappear, leave, find, have

(1) __________ Piglet found Pooh's message, Pooh left for the Rocky Mountains.
(2) Pooh __________ back about four months __________ he went to the Rocky Mountains.
(3) Pooh's friends __________ a big party __________ Pooh __________ back.
